Results.ReviewText: I'm really impressed with this little, extremely light weight power house. First favorable impression is that it weighs practically nothing. Secondly how fast the big honkin' battery charges quickly. When I mowed my lawn there were some long areas. The automatic governor kicked right in and made easy work of the long grass. I mulched the lawn instead of bagging it, very effective mulching indeed. The lawn looks like it was all bagged. Did I mention it was very light-weight. It takes little effort to maneuver it around the yard. Don't let the all plastic construction fool you. It is tough as nails strong. One reviewer was lamenting that it would probably be seriously damaged by throwing it off the back of a pickup truck. Oh really?!?! And what lawn mower won't be.  And let's not forget the smooth battery power. One charge finished my average sized yard (your mileage may vary). It was such a pleasure to just push a button and squeeze the bail handle and you're going. Effortless light-weight mowing. I'm extremely happy with my Wild Badger Battery Power Mower.
Results.Title: Wild Badger Mower
